note: PHYSCLOTH v1: secondary motion (hair, skirt / tabard flaps, cape, tail, fins, hanging gear), PRESENTATION ONLY, read by Scripts/Physics/SecondaryMotion.cs (LateUpdate after the Animator, render time only: no sim read, no RNG, no PhysX, simhash identical on/off). MASTER SWITCH is in physics.json: "secondary": { "enabled": false } (ships OFF); QA twins -secondary:on / -secondary:off. characters[].name = roster id (Sobek has no roster row yet, so his row is inert); row enabled; per chain: enabled, skinned (true ONLY when a mesh has vertex weight on these joints; false = the chain is skipped), bones parents first, stiffness 1/s^2, damping 1/s, gravity x world.gravityMps2, maxAngleDeg per bone, rootInfluence..tipInfluence along the chain (0 = animated pose only), tipAxis (bone-local aim axis, +Y on this rig) and tipLengthM (model metres) for a bone with no listed child. No new joint names: the shared 106 rig is gated by name (clip_gates G-rig, clip_sets_gates). Combat code must never read these bones.

chains.name: hair_back
chains.note: Joan_Hair is its own mesh but 100% weighted to Head (measured): the 3 hair joints exist and carry NO vertex weight, so this chain moves nothing until the hair is re-skinned (tools\hair_reskin.py draft -> out\Joan_Hair_chain_draft.glb, needs Dom's LOOK OK). Set skinned true only with that glb. Segment lengths 0.086/0.088 m (measured), the hair shell is only 0.23 m tall and ends at the nape, so amplitude is centimetres. Gravity small: it is cropped hair, not a ponytail.

chains.name: tabard_front
chains.note: Only gear\joan_tabard.glb carries weight on fk_skirt_f (190 vertex weights, 262 vertices >= 0.30, measured); invisible until the tabard is equipped. One leaf joint under Hips = a hinge flap, no ripple. The owned vertices hang 0.09 m below the joint and reach 0.18 m from it (measured) -> tipLengthM 0.18.

chains.name: tabard_back
chains.note: Same as tabard_front for fk_skirt_b (156 vertex weights, 217 vertices >= 0.30, 0.185 m reach, measured).

chains.name: cape
chains.note: fk_cape_01..03 hang from Spine2 (0.196 m segments, measured) but NO shipped mesh is weighted to them (Layer_Tunic, tabard, Steel: none). Joan has no cape. Row kept so a cape asset can switch on by data.

chains.name: cape
chains.note: Pitborn_combat.glb is ONE mesh (Body, 250k tris) with zero weight on every fk_ and twist-chain joint (measured); his gear is baked into it and the rig has the same fk_cape_01..03 joints. Nothing can move until a cloth / rag / chain part is built and skinned to these joints in the bind_pit route. Row ready for that part.

chains.name: loin_front
chains.note: Same as cape: needs a modelled tasset / loincloth skinned to fk_skirt_f.

chains.name: loin_back
chains.note: Same as cape: needs a modelled part skinned to fk_skirt_b.

chains.name: hanging_gear
chains.note: Leaf joint under Spine2 (back socket). Candidate for a dangling strap / chain on the maul harness once such a part exists.
